data.name: Widgets.Camera.Description
data.value: Shows one of your IP cameras live.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.NotConfigured
data.value: Choose a camera in the widget settings

data.name: Widgets.Camera.UpdateRequired
data.value: Update Macro Deck to see this stream

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.CameraDescription
data.value: A camera added on the IP Camera integration page.

data.name: Setup.Description
data.value: Every camera you add becomes a video stream and a widget source.

data.name: Setup.UrlDescription
data.value: The camera's snapshot, MJPEG or RTSP address. The Mi 360 1080p exposes RTSP after a community firmware hack, and go2rtc can serve it as MJPEG instead.

data.name: Setup.FpsDescription
data.value: How often the camera is read. 5 is smooth enough for a tile and keeps the camera load low.

data.name: Setup.MaxWidthDescription
data.value: Frames are scaled down to this width. 0 keeps the camera's own size.

data.name: Setup.NameRequired
data.value: Enter a name for the camera.

data.name: Setup.UrlWrongScheme
data.value: Use an http(s) URL for a snapshot or MJPEG camera, or an rtsp URL for an RTSP camera.

data.name: Setup.FpsRange
data.value: Use a frame rate between 1 and 15.

data.name: Setup.FfmpegMissing
data.value: RTSP needs ffmpeg on this computer. Install it, add it to the PATH, then try again.

data.name: Setup.Probe.Unreachable
data.value: No answer from the camera. Check the URL and that the camera is reachable from this computer.

data.name: Setup.Probe.Unauthorized
data.value: The camera refused the username or password.

data.name: Setup.Probe.HttpError
data.value: The camera answered with an error. Check the URL.

data.name: Setup.Probe.NotJpeg
data.value: The URL answered, but not with a JPEG picture. For a go2rtc camera, use the transcoded stream whose name ends in _mjpeg.

data.name: Setup.Probe.NoFrame
data.value: The stream opened but sent no JPEG frame. For go2rtc, add the ffmpeg transcoder and use the _mjpeg stream.

data.name: Setup.UnknownStep
data.value: This setup step is no longer available. Close the dialog and start again.

data.name: Issues.FfmpegMissing.Description
data.value: At least one camera uses RTSP, which this plugin converts with ffmpeg. Install ffmpeg and add it to the PATH, or set IPCAM_FFMPEG_PATH to the executable.
